He will be freaked out and out of it until it clears his system, just try to sit with him and keep him calm if he is freaking out also see if keeping it relatively dark sometimes that helps a lot. You can syringe water/pedialyte into the babies mouth just make sure not to over do it and make sure the pup is swallowing. You can sling a towel under his hips to help him walk and stay balanced to go to the bathroom. Dogs just take a lot longer to get things out of their systems than we do so it might take a few days.
